content: Ogosa budonte Barjosa gaanana oynna peensa karra oynnadar woyayse ke daaka keam i haapade. Peendar ko hannaar, bazindar ko hannaar, haaqandar ko hannaar, jibare jibarshoamadettsi oynna goynaka peendar nivayna jibarshayna jibarenam kedi yedidine.
Lay dehea Barjosa maytaminam yedaa ab Barjosa gaana haynsa utambara ki nivaka i haapade. Peenbee bazinbeam kenin kaysoadettsi hayamo kena imbhaana oynna Barjosa gaananana yisa upsin dheg hayayse,
“Wosa Barjoana waadimayna eenasa wotindar maytamin wonin qanenka yekka peenam ko hannaar, bazinam ko hannaar, haaqanam ko hannaar kayseebhode!” kena ki hamade.
Maytamin daran qandhaana eenasaar paydinam i qansade; Israveel eenasa muldhan wulsa maytamin daran qandhaana shii eedi tobbhaa kaysa apo oydi (144,000) ke dahade.

Ogosa budonte, marrato! Hayyear paydana damima kattsi thoothi eedi i haapade. Kediar zarsin wulbee, muldhan wulbee, peen wulbee, apon wulbera utaanane; apala cawli qaadhayse meetha haccha yisa aanindar yedayse bitamon borkotonbee Yaatabesa birante woyayse ke dahade.
Barjosa gaanana wul bitamon borkotonbee, donzanabee, damma oynnabesa gasante woyayse ke dahade. Bitamon borkotonsa birante kumpurdhayse Barjona goodimada yin ke giyade:

content.text: rooro wul lay wosa Barjoana ko dee; amiin!”

content: Donzanasaar kalaa ina yi giyna: “Igina apalan cawlin qaadhaana haybene? Hamora ke nivaa?” ki hamade.
Intaar “Imbo! Ya dhesaada dhese” kina i hamade. Kidiar ina yin ki giyade: “Igina gebhon gaalera utaana eenane; yisa apalanamaar Yaatasa zombhinka shivayse ke calshade.

content.text: Bitamon borkotondar dooqaar kesa shipo kida maate.
Keeda kaara os kedi daaqardhehe, dheebardhehe;
Harrna hambhidianna, bitamon borkotonsa shaarinte dahaa Yaata keam gishea kida dee;
sadan imen noqon aapin elendar keam kida entse.
Barjoar ermitin wulam kesa aapira kida qode”
